limitations: This is W3 coordinated multi-session evidence against a disposable local change provider, not W4 completion against an authenticated forge or deployment system.

The gates and live lanes exercise the same deterministic Git blob and changed-path verifier; they prove separate attributable sessions and frozen-coordinate behavior, not two different hosted production surfaces.
The built-in OMP owner and reviewer roles expose bash; assignments and transcripts constrained each child, but the runtime roles are not capability-level filesystem read-only.

One hub wait reported that RespectablePike was no longer running after its delivered follow-up even though its persisted owner state and proof were complete. EventualMouse mistyped its first cwd so no verifier ran, then executed the one valid assigned verifier successfully; both runtime wrinkles are retained rather than hidden.
OMP delivery remains D0 overall because the separate plugin-manager D1 gate is unresolved.
